rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 7 European sites (KCL, RUNMC, UMCU, ARC, UCAM, CIMH, KI) from the LEAP project (KI excluded due to low participant numbers).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "MRI data were acquired on 3T scanners at multiple sites in Europe-King's College London (KCL), Radboud University Nijmegen Medical Centre (RUNMC), University Medical Centre Utrecht (UMCU), Autism Research Centre (ARC), University of Cambridge (UCAM), Central Institute of Mental Health, Mannheim (CIMH), and Karolinska Institutet (KI)."

rci2_using_epd.detail: LEAP (EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS Longitudinal European Autism Project) used as the normative reference cohort.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "All analyses were based on the EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS multisite Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) with participants with autism (n = 282) and typically developing (TD) controls (n = 221) between 6 and 30 years of age."

rci3_epd_name.detail: EU-AIMS/AIMS-2-TRIALS Longitudinal European Autism Project (LEAP) used as the source dataset for both autism participants and typically developing controls.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The dataset from the EU-AIMS/AIMS2TRIALS LEAP project was used for the current analyses-a large multicenter European project"

rci5_n.detail: Overall typically developing controls from LEAP after quality control exclusions; not all participants completed all fMRI sessions (subsamples per task reported in Supplementary Tables S1-S5).
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The above criteria resulted in the inclusion of data for analyses from the following participants: 282 participants with autism ... and 221 typically developing controls"

rci6_sex.detail: Overall TD controls; male percentage (63.8%) reported directly; male_n derived as 221 × 0.638 = 141; female_n estimated as 221 - 141 = 80.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "221 typically developing controls (age range 6.9-29.8 years; mean = 17.0; sd = 5.5; 63.8% male)."

rci7_age.detail: Overall TD controls; age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "221 typically developing controls (age range 6.9-29.8 years; mean = 17.0; sd = 5.5; 63.8% male)."
